segments.zh: 现在你已经完成了你的研究。

segments.en: You know everything about the company.
segments.zh: 你知道关于公司的一切。

segments.en: What else should you do?
Once you've read up on the company, you've got to spend some time thinking about yourself.
segments.zh: 读完公司后，你必须花一些时间思考自己。

segments.en: You've got to prepare to sell yourself to the company.
segments.zh: 你必须准备把自己卖给公司。

segments.en: So to sell yourself, to really demonstrate them why you are the perfect person for the job.
segments.zh: 所以推销自己，真正展示他们为什么你是这份工作的完美人选。

segments.en: Right.
Because a lot of people think about why they want to work for the company, right?
segments.zh: 因为很多人都在想他们为什么要为公司工作，对吧？

segments.en: Because they feel like they're aligned with the core values or the message of the company resonates with them.
segments.zh: 因为他们觉得他们与核心价值观一致，或者公司的信息与他们产生了共鸣。

segments.en: But what the interviewer really wants to hear is how you, the interviewee, is going to benefit the company.
segments.zh: 但面试官真正想听到的是，你，受访者，将如何使公司受益。

segments.en: What are you going to bring to the company?
segments.zh: 你打算给公司带来什么？

segments.en: Right.
And this is the most important part, is to know what are your skills, right?
segments.zh: 而这是最重要的部分，是知道你的技能是什么，对吧？

segments.en: Yes.
And it's not enough to just say, well, I am a great leader.
segments.zh: 仅仅说，好吧，我是一个伟大的领导者是不够的。

segments.en: Yeah.
Right.
So if you are a great leader, you should be ready to give an example of how you have demonstrated to be a great leader.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您是一位伟大的领导者，您应该准备好举例说明您如何证明自己是一位伟大的领导者。

segments.en: Yes.
All right.
So maybe like an example like, I'm a really strong leader because in my previous job, I had the best JD Power ratings for employee satisfaction.
segments.zh: 所以也许就像一个例子一样，我是一个非常强大的领导者，因为在我之前的工作中，我的 JD 功率评级在员工满意度方面是最好的。

segments.en: Okay.
So you're actually showing with numbers or with facts that you are a great leader.
segments.zh: 所以你实际上是在用数字或事实表明你是一个伟大的领导者。

segments.en: Yeah.
So the key thing here, I think, is identify what your strengths and skills are.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，这里的关键是确定你的优势和技能是什么。

segments.en: Think of specific examples.
If you can, give numbers and show how you can bring this skill and your experiences to the new company.
segments.zh: 如果可以，请提供数字并展示如何将这项技能和您的经验带到新公司。

segments.en: And now, well, you're ready to sell yourself.
segments.zh: 现在，好吧，你已经准备好推销自己了。

segments.en: You've done your research.
segments.zh: 你已经完成了你的研究。

segments.en: Now you have all of these things in your mind.
segments.zh: 现在你的脑海里有所有这些东西。

segments.en: You have to practice.
Yes.
Right.
A much overlooked stage in the preparation.
segments.zh: 准备过程中一个被忽视的阶段。

segments.en: Yeah.
A lot of people think it through.
They write things down, but don't really practice.
segments.zh: 他们把东西写下来，但没有真正练习。

segments.en: Yeah.
So I know you have a few tips about how you can practice interviewing effectively.
segments.zh: 所以我知道你有一些关于如何有效地练习面试的技巧。

segments.en: Okay.
Well, the first thing that you should do is use your friends.
segments.zh: 好吧，你应该做的第一件事就是使用你的朋友。

segments.en: Yeah.
Right.
They got to be good for something.
segments.zh: 他们必须对某事有好处。

segments.en: Exactly.
And well, probably your friends are also working at a company.
segments.zh: 好吧，可能你的朋友也在一家公司工作。

segments.en: Maybe they're managers, or maybe they've interviewed someone before already.
segments.zh: 也许他们是经理，或者他们以前已经采访过某人。

segments.en: So you can set up a mini interview and have them pretend that they are the interviewer and ask you these questions.
segments.zh: 因此，您可以设置一个迷你面试，让他们假装他们是面试官并问你这些问题。

segments.en: And you're trying to answer seriously.
And I'm sure that your friends can give you some great feedback.
segments.zh: 我相信你的朋友可以给你一些很好的反馈。

segments.en: Maybe what you did right, maybe what you did wrong.
segments.zh: 也许你做对了什么，也许你做错了什么。

segments.en: So that's a really good way.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常好的方法。

segments.en: And another thing is also you can record yourself.
segments.zh: 另一件事是你可以自己记录。

segments.en: Yes.
Right.
Yeah.
If you have a video camera or even a web, I mean, many people have a webcam like right in your laptop.
segments.zh: 如果您有摄像机甚至网络，我的意思是，许多人在您的笔记本电脑中都有一个类似的网络摄像头。

segments.en: Record yourself actually doing the practice interview with your friends.
segments.zh: 记录自己实际与朋友进行练习采访。

segments.en: And this is really useful because you can later see what you recorded and detect some of the things that maybe aren't really useful or good.
segments.zh: 这真的很有用，因为您以后可以看到您记录的内容并检测了一些可能不太有用或不太好的东西。

segments.en: You know, for example, posture is a really important aspect.
segments.zh: 例如，你知道，姿势是一个非常重要的方面。

segments.en: So what do you mean posture?
segments.zh: 那你的姿势是什么意思？

segments.en: So the way that you are sitting down in your seat.
segments.zh: 所以你坐在座位上的方式。

segments.en: Yep.
And how you are expressing yourself with your hands.
segments.zh: 以及你如何用手表达自己。

segments.en: Yep.
Some people, you know, they move a lot during the interview because of course you're nervous.
segments.zh: 有些人，你知道，他们在面试中经常会移动，因为你当然很紧张。

segments.en: So maybe they're moving from side to side or playing with their feet or playing with something on the table or moving their hands in an awkward way.
segments.zh: 所以也许他们从一边移动到另一边，或者玩他们的脚，或者在桌子上玩东西，或者以一种尴尬的方式移动他们的手。

segments.en: So those are the things that you have to watch out for.
segments.zh: 所以这些是你必须注意的事情。

segments.en: Yes.
So I guess it's really important to sit up straight and to show that you are powerful and in control.
segments.zh: 所以我想坐直并表明你是强大和控制非常重要。

segments.en: And another really great thing is eye contact, right?
segments.zh: 另一个真正伟大的事情是眼神交流，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah.
Yeah.
We were talking about this earlier.
And why is eye contact so important?
segments.zh: 为什么眼神交流如此重要？

segments.en: If an interviewee maintains eye contact with me for like most of the interview, I feel like they have really good people skills.
segments.zh: 如果受访者像大部分采访一样与我保持眼神交流，我觉得他们的人际交往能力非常好。

segments.en: In my opinion, I would say they have a lot of self-confidence.
segments.zh: 在我看来，我会说他们有很多自信。

segments.en: Yeah, I'd agree.
Right?
Yep.
Because if a person is looking down or not looking directly at you, it's either one of two things in my opinion.
segments.zh: 因为如果一个人低头或不直视你，在我看来，这要么是两件事之一。

segments.en: It's either they are not confident enough with themselves or they are lying to you.
segments.zh: 要么他们对自己没有足够的信心，要么他们在骗你。

segments.en: Yes.
Right?
Yeah.
Or also they just they don't have good people skills.
segments.zh: 或者他们只是他们没有良好的人际交往能力。

segments.en: Yeah.
Yeah.
Which is a problem in today's sort of knowledge-based economy.
segments.zh: 这是当今知识经济中的一个问题。

segments.en: Exactly.
So it's really important to maintain eye contact.
segments.zh: 所以保持眼神交流真的很重要。

segments.en: And one other really important thing related to eye contact posture is the handshake.
segments.zh: 与眼神接触姿势相关的另一件非常重要的事情是握手。

segments.en: When you get to the interview, it's really, really important to give a firm, good handshake.
segments.zh: 当你参加面试时，进行坚定、良好的握手非常非常重要。

segments.en: So what qualifies as a firm, good handshake?
segments.zh: 那么什么是有资格的，良好的握手呢？

segments.en: Well, you don't have to prove that you are ultra strong, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，你不必证明你是超强的，对吧？

segments.en: So you don't have to squeeze the other person's hand really hard.
segments.zh: 所以你不必用力捏别人的手。

segments.en: And like break their hand.
Exactly.
It's not like a strength contest.
No.
A good firm handshake is squeezing normally, not too tight, not too loose, but your entire palm, your entire hand has to be in contact with the other person's palm or hand.
segments.zh: 一个好的握手是正常的握手，不是太紧，不是太松，而是你的整个手掌，你的整个手都必须与对方的手掌或手接触。

segments.en: Yes.
Don't give them the fingers, you know, like some people give you only four fingers or half their hand.
segments.zh: 不要给他们手指，你知道，就像有些人只给你四根手指或他们的一半手。

segments.en: Yeah.
I hate that.
I hate it too.
And this goes for men and for women because a lot of women do this.
segments.zh: 这适用于男性和女性，因为很多女性都这样做。

segments.en: Yeah.
I call this the dead fish handshake.
It is kind of like a dead fish or the dead hand handshake.
segments.zh: 它有点像死鱼或死手握手。

segments.en: Yeah.
I absolutely agree with you on this one.
So nice firm handshake.
Yeah.
firm handshake and well, these are our tips for preparing for the interview, everything you have to do before it.
segments.zh: 坚定的握手，这些是我们为面试做准备的秘诀，是你之前要做的一切。

segments.en: I'm sure there are a lot more things out there.
segments.zh: 我敢肯定还有很多东西。

segments.en: So and I'm sure our users have some insight on this as well.
segments.zh: 所以我相信我们的用户对此也有一些见解。

segments.en: Yeah.
I'd love to hear it because like I told you, I love job interviews.
segments.zh: 我很想听，因为就像我告诉你的那样，我喜欢工作面试。

segments.en: Yeah.
So come to our website at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: Leave us your comments.
Maybe you've had a good experience with a job interview or maybe a bad one or maybe even as an interviewer, you've interviewed some really interesting people.
segments.zh: 也许你在求职面试中有很好的经历，或者可能是一个糟糕的面试，甚至可能是面试官，你采访了一些非常有趣的人。

segments.en: And you've got some great tips to share with us.
segments.zh: 您有一些很棒的技巧可以与我们分享。

segments.en: Exactly.
So come to our website, leave your questions, leave your comments, share your experiences with our other users.
segments.zh: 因此，请访问我们的网站，留下您的问题，留下您的评论，与我们的其他用户分享您的经验。

segments.en: And Erica and I will also be there to participate in the discussion.
segments.zh: 埃里卡和我也将参加讨论。

segments.en: All right, guys.
Well, thanks for listening.
And until next time, goodbye.
Goodbye.
